children.label: c
children.prompt: By drawing a suitable straight line on the grid, solve the equation $x^3-5x^2-x+14=0$. Give your answers as estimates to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}x^3-5x^2-x+14&=0\\5x^2-x^3-4&=10-x\end{aligned}$$

Draw $y=10-x$ on the graph from part b. Read the $x$-coordinates of the three intersections: $x\approx-1.5,\ 2.0,\ 4.5$.

spec.description: Cubic and descending straight line on common axes. The line is dashed to distinguish the two source-blue series without relying on colour.
